description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin 'dialogadvtab' that creates an advanced tab in dialog windows, allowing configuration of attributes like id, direction, styles, and classes for DOM elements within the editor.

methods.name: setupAdvParams
methods.description: Sets the value of a dialog field based on the attribute of a DOM element.

methods.name: commitAdvParams
methods.description: Commits the value from a dialog field to the attribute of a DOM element, firing a 'dirChanged' event if the 'dir' attribute changes.
